description: This file implements data model transaction management, including starting, adding operations, committing, and aborting transactions, with support for cascading notifications and vendor-specific hooks.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_Start
methods.description: Initializes a new data model transaction, starting underlying database and vendor transactions.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_Add
methods.description: Adds an operation (set, add, delete) to the current transaction, storing relevant data for later commit.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_Commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, invoking notify callbacks, handling cascading, and starting a new transaction for notifications.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_Abort
methods.description: Aborts the current transaction, rolling back database changes and undoing instance modifications.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_IsWithinTransaction
methods.description: Returns true if currently within an active transaction.

methods.name: DM_TRANS_GetParamWritesByPathSpec
methods.description: Retrieves a list of parameters written in the current transaction matching a path specification.

methods.name: ClearTransaction
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a transaction's operation list and resets its state.
